overall: The AG found the Westwood FS1 Working Group is not a public body under the OML because it does not act collectively (no quorum requirement, no votes or collective advice), so no violation; individual-official claims were not analyzed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the Working Group is a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law because it serves a public purpose and advises the Select Board.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Working Group does not act collectively, we find that it fails the second prong of the public body analysis and therefore is not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Working Group's Connelly argument (advisory committee to a single official) was raised in response; the AG did not reach it because the group failed the second prong.
allegations.key_passage: we need not analyze whether the Working Group satisfies the first and third prongs or whether the Working Group falls within the Connelly exception.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges three named town officials individually violated the Open Meeting Law; the letter does not analyze these individual claims.
allegations.key_passage: The complaint also alleges that Assistant Town Administrator Molly Fitzpatrick, Select Board member Marianne LeBlanc Cummings, and Attorney Ahearn
